title: How to evaluate agents and skills
description:
Agents can write code, use tools, and interact with Ethereum. But how do we check that they do the right thing, and find out which instructions help them succeed?
We will share what we learned from agent and skill evals in two recent projects. With ETH Skills, we tested original and rewritten skills on the same tasks to see which context helped and which introduced problems. In Agents Arena, we watched agents with different models and efforts work through onchain challenges.
We will discuss how to choose useful tasks, compare runs, check success, and learn from failures. We will also look at what a score leaves out, including differences in models and tools, variation between runs, and the limits of small samples. The aim is to help builders use evaluations to make better decisions about their agents and skills.
